theorems.name: mul_total
theorems.doc: (C) An `I32F32` product never panics (the exact product fits i128).
theorems.statement: @[step] theorem mul_total (a b : Std.I64) : mul a b ⦃ _ => True ⦄
theorems.proof:
@[step] theorem mul_total (a b : Std.I64) : mul a b ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold mul
  have ha1 : -2 ^ 63 ≤ a.val := by scalar_tac
  have ha2 : a.val < 2 ^ 63 := by scalar_tac
  have hb1 : -2 ^ 63 ≤ b.val := by scalar_tac
  have hb2 : b.val < 2 ^ 63 := by scalar_tac
  have h1 : -2 ^ 126 ≤ a.val * b.val := by nlinarith
  have h2 : a.val * b.val ≤ 2 ^ 126 := by nlinarith
  have hf := frac_val
  step*

div.lean:
def div
  (a : Std.I64) (b : Std.I64) : Result (core.result.Result Std.I64 Error) := do
  if b = 0#i64
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err Error.DivZero)
  else
    let i ← lift (IScalar.cast .I128 a)
    let i1 ← i * ONE_WIDE
    let i2 ← lift (IScalar.cast .I128 b)
    let i3 ← i1 / i2
    narrow i3
